verdict.rationale: Docs describe incremental sync and CDC log-position tracking that let Airbyte resume reading from where it left off (airbyte-docs-22, airbyte-docs-15/25/38/42), which is checkpoint-like behavior for interrupted syncs, but there is no documentation of automatic retry of transient failures, and a community report describes needing a manual workaround to get a large sync to behave correctly rather than automatic recovery (airbyte-comm-4). missing for 10: explicit automatic retry-on-failure mechanism, documented mid-sync checkpoint/resume (vs. only cursor-based incremental sync), independent confirmation that interrupted syncs resume rather than restart.
